value.rationale: This is a natural complete all-length and all-arm-count recovery classification on a nontrivial cyclic network family. A single even arm allows invertibility, two force a kernel, and the all-odd regime changes at even/odd numbers of paths. Exact attainable 2-adic spectral gaps quantify stability, not merely the possibility of zeros; compressing 2^m frequency values into O(product(ell_i+1)) parameter cases enables concrete computation.
